text:
emma_sales: Heads up — Neptune Health wants to start a 2-week POC tomorrow. They asked for SOC 2 evidence + a temporary NDA and a short attestation so their procurement/privacy teams can approve access to a redacted evidence bucket. Can legal + security expedite? Need a yes/no by EOD so I can commit dates on our side.
micaela_legal: We can do a short-form temp NDA plus a limited attestation. I need a specific artifact list and confirmation on data residency/scope. I can draft tonight but need Emma to confirm customer contact.
emma_sales: Adding context: customer contact is sophie@neptune (I'll share full contact off-channel). POC will be purely evaluation data, US-only. @raj_se will run the infra for the demo.
raj_se: I can provision a dedicated POC sandbox (us-west-2) with RBAC and read-only creds. For the attestation artifacts, propose we surface: redacted SOC2 excerpt, pen-test summary, infra diagram, and a short access/readme. Olivia — does that cover security asks?
olivia_security: That should cover it. We can produce a redacted SOC2 extract (remove UUIDs/PII), a pen-test executive summary, and an "evidence window" README explaining what was shared and retention. We cannot share raw S3 objects or raw system logs without a legal exception. ETA for artifacts: ~48 hrs. If they need immediate proof, we can provide time-limited presigned links (72h) once NDA is signed.
micaela_legal: Ok. I'll draft the temp NDA and a brief attestation template. Two questions for Emma: 1) Confirm US-only. 2) Do they need the full SOC 2 Type II report or just an excerpt + attestation?
emma_sales: Confirmed US-only and they explicitly requested "attestation + evidence snapshot" not the full report. Also flagged DPA — they want a standard DPA; we have the link ready.
olivia_security: One more note: if they ask for system or audit logs for the POC, we need to deny by default. Logs include IPs and could be sensitive. Offer aggregated metrics instead.
micaela_legal: Agreed. NDA will include: prohibition on retaining logs, limited use clause, 30-day deletion requirement for any downloaded artifacts, and standard non-disclosure duration. I'll add a short exception flow if procurement insists on logs (legal review required).
raj_se: I'll start collecting screenshots and the infra diagram. Proposed artifact list for upload: SOC2-excerpt-redacted.pdf, pen-test-summary-redacted.pdf, infra-architecture.png, poc-access-readme.md. Please confirm so I can stage them.
emma_sales: :thumbsup: Confirmed. I'm going to push the DocuSign request to Sophie and procurement now. Once signed, can we get presigned links + README posted in this thread?
olivia_security: :eyes: Starting redaction pass now. Will post presigned links here after NDA is in place. If legal wants a copy of the README for review before publishing, ping me and I'll share draft.
micaela_legal: Draft NDA and short attestation ready — sending to Emma for quick review in ~30m. If no major edits, I'll route for signature.
emma_sales: Got the draft. Small tweak on clause 4.1 which I sent to Micaela. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround — should unblock POC by tomorrow afternoon if signatures + upload complete.
